Step 1 · What happens in fairy tales? · 3 min

Shout out what fairy tales usually have. Then click each one.

1. A brave, good prince

The prince seems brave and good... at first.

2. A wicked queen or stepmother

The queen is a "step-grandmother" people call a witch.

3. True love

The prince falls in love with a farmer's daughter.

4. The bad guy is punished

Is she? Wait for Chapter 9.

5. Happily ever after

Is there one? Wait for Chapter 9.

6. Magic

A giant tree that walks.

The monster's first tale starts like a fairy tale. Does it keep the rules?

02
Step 2 · Words to know · 2 min

Before we read

  • heir: the person who will be king or queen next
  • regent: someone who rules until the real king is old enough
  • succumbed to grief: died of sadness
  • treachery: betrayal
  • vengeance: revenge
  • injustice: something unfair
  • pantomime: a show, play-acting
  • justifications: reasons people give to say they were right
  • scepticism: doubt, not believing
  • sapling: a young tree

Step 7 · Chapter 8 questions · 9 min · in your book · full sentences

Chapter 8: "The First Tale"

1 / 3
1

Why does the king marry again?

Start: The king marries again because...
Look for "I must remarry," the king decided.
He marries "For the good of my prince and of my kingdom": the marriage makes both kingdoms stronger.
2

What rumours spread about the new queen when the king falls ill?

Start: People say that the queen...
Look for "Rumour began to spread".
People say she is poisoning the king, and that she uses magic to look much younger than she really is.
3

Why do the prince and the farmer's daughter run away?

Start: They run away because the queen...
What does the queen want to do with the prince?
The queen wants to marry the prince to keep her power. He refuses, so he runs away to marry the farmer's daughter in the next kingdom.
4

What does the prince find when he wakes up under the yew tree?

Start: When the prince wakes up, he finds...
Look for "But his beloved did not wake."
The farmer's daughter is dead, and there is blood on his hands and a knife beside them, so it looks as if he killed her.
5

At the end of the chapter, Conor says the queen "deserved it" and looks up at his bedroom window. What is he thinking about?

Start: Conor is thinking about...
Who is sleeping in Conor's bedroom? What does he ask the monster?
He is thinking about Grandma, who sleeps in his room. He hopes the monster will get rid of her too: "I don't suppose you can help me with her?"
08
Step 8 · Chapter 9 questions · 10 min · in your book · full sentences

Chapter 9: "The Rest of the First Tale"

1 / 3
6

What does the monster really do to the queen?

Start: The monster...
Look for "When the villagers lit the flames".
It saves her from the fire and carries her far away to a village by the sea, where she lives in peace.
7

Who really killed the farmer's daughter, and why?

Start: The farmer's daughter was killed by... because...
Look for "He needed the fury of the villagers to help him."
The prince killed her. He wanted the villagers to be angry with the queen, so they would help him overthrow her.
8

Why does the monster save the queen?

Start: The monster saves the queen because...
Look for "Because what she was not..."
Because she was not a murderer. She may have been a witch, but she did not kill the farmer's daughter: "Because what she was not, was a murderer."
9

The monster says, "Sometimes people need to lie to themselves most of all." What lie does the prince tell himself?

Start: The prince tells himself that...
He pretends to be shocked when he wakes up. Who does he say is to blame?
He tells himself the queen is to blame and that he did it "for the good of the kingdom", so he never has to face what he did.
10

Claim: The prince is not the hero he seems. Which quote proves it best? Write the letter and why.

A"He became a much beloved king, the monster said, who ruled happily until the end of his long days."
B"I never said she killed the farmer's daughter, the monster said."
C"When he awoke, he acted out a pantomime should anyone be watching."
Start: Quote __ is best because it shows that...
Use Tuesday's rule: relevant, short, exact. Which one is about the prince pretending?
C. A "pantomime" is an act: his shock was fake. A shows people loved him, the opposite. B is about the queen, not the prince.

Add one clue to each page

PageCh.ClueWhat it shows
Family8Conor asks the monster about Grandma: "I don't suppose you can help me with her?"This shows that ...
This shows that Conor sees Grandma as an enemy he wants the monster to get rid of.
Supernatural vs. Reality9After waking at 12.07, he finds "a fresh, new and very solid sapling" in the floor.This shows that ...
This shows that the monster may be real, because a dream cannot leave a solid tree behind.
